why: Both turn canvas material into room-specific humour; the boundary is whether a clash is retold in fandom lore or merely an in-joke.

why.T3-081: C0190599 and C0522363 cast the Tyler1 fight as Estonia's experience of occupation and independence wars, which is T3-081 rather than T3-050 taunts or T3-031 in-jokes.

why.T3-014: C0744413 and C1189149 send canvas planning to the Estonia Discord so builders avoid working against each other; this is moving planning into a chat, not arguing which chat or keeping the thread.

why.T3-028: The codes offer, run, sign off, and report the bot/scripts used for the Estonian design, which is running scripts for the work, not arguing their fairness or extra accounts.

why.T3-004: C0219401, C0329850, C0168213, C0539510, C0791561 and C0620458 explain the redesign's look, artistic aims, details, completion and corrections, which is settling the mark's design.
why.T3-066: C0695718, C1217782 and C0882394 show the design decision being put to a vote and the vote's meaning contested, satisfying putting decisions to a vote.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-004 alone would not carry the room's explicit vote/poll about the redesign and the correction of what the vote meant.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0695718, C1217782 and C0882394 show the design decision being put to a vote and the vote's meaning contested, satisfying T3-066's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-066 if forced to one; we would lose the vote mechanism but keep the design settlement.

why.T3-015: C0630303 asks moderators to sticky an r/place megathread, the gathering act of T3-015; C1210770's filter request is not enough for T3-063 without a standing removal rule.

why.T3-189: C0727905, C0312366 and C0074117 fear that canvas exposure will bring rule-breaking newcomers and swamp the sub.
why.T3-044: C1425680 is a visitor who followed the visible logo back into r/scp, the recruitment side.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-189 alone would miss the actual visitor led to the sub by the mark.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1425680 reports coming to SCP because they saw the logo, satisfying T3-044's recruitment gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-044; the main weight is fear of the influx.

why.T3-122: C1199384 sends a greeting from Armenia to Estonia with no deal attached, which is sending greetings, not an envoy errand or making up after quarrel.

why.T3-003: C1485992 reports the member's own single pixel placed on the USSR flag before losing interest, which is reporting one's own placing labour, not a room work report.

why.T3-015: C1194275 centralises r/place posts in one thread to keep the front page clean, the gathering act of T3-015; C1143106 is only a supporting complaint.

why.T3-070: The bulk of the item circulates blueprints, coordinates, reference images, direct links, spatial plans and locations for placers to follow, which is sharing coordinates, templates and how-to; other themes are named in also_present.

why.T3-005: C1036898, C1004375, C0952860 and C1456679 raise alarms about Tyler1 destroying the art and call for help/fighting, which is defending the work against attackers, not pleading with attackers or tracing.

why.T3-081: C0190599 and C0522363 cast the Tyler1 fight as Estonia's experience of occupation and independence wars, which is T3-081 rather than T3-050 taunts or T3-031 in-jokes.

why.T3-136: C1077710, C0343231 and C1092468 doubt that enough people can sustain the work at all.
why.T3-074: C1522389, C0117955 and C0880795 work around the timer, tied-up pixels and delayed hands while trying to build.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-021 covers keeping and repairing the mark but not the explicit doubt that the room has enough people for the work.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1077710, C0343231 and C1092468 doubt participation and strength, satisfying T3-136.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-021 covers repair and watch but not the practical workaround of the cooldown and too few hands.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1522389, C0117955 and C0880795 describe the timer, tied-up pixels and delayed helping, satisfying T3-074.
